text: When an ODE system is linearized around a fixed point using the Jacobian matrix, what property determines whether the fixed point is locally stable?
choices: The determinant of the Jacobian alone
The sign of the eigenvalues of the Jacobian
The rank of the Jacobian matrix
explanation: Stability analysis via linearization determines local stability from the sign of the Jacobian's eigenvalues: negative real parts for all eigenvalues means stable, any eigenvalue with a positive real part means unstable. The determinant alone (the product of eigenvalues) cannot distinguish a stable from an unstable configuration with the same sign product, rank concerns degeneracy or singularity rather than stability, and symmetry is unrelated to determining stability.
